name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group for a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group, considering your primary goals for the new space and having an idea of your functional needs and aesthetic preferences can be very helpful. Gathering any existing architectural plans or property surveys for your home can also streamline the initial assessment. This preparation allows us to better understand your vision during the initial consultation. Our integrated design-build process will then guide you through detailed planning and material selection for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider your goals for the space, functional needs, aesthetic preferences, and gather any existing architectural plans. This aids initial consultation.
